---
title: Accessibility
description: Our approach to making public information usable, and how to identify problems.
---

TSP aims to make its public information usable across screen sizes, input methods, and assistive technologies. This alpha uses semantic headings, keyboard-accessible navigation, a skip link, readable color contrast, descriptive links, and alternative text for meaningful images.

The site respects reduced-motion preferences and does not depend on animations. Search and category filters supplement ordinary page navigation. Research publications should provide text explanations and accessible data alternatives alongside future visualizations.

This is an accessibility commitment, not a claim of formal certification or a complete audit. If a page, resource, or interaction creates a barrier, please describe the page and the difficulty through a route listed on [Get Involved](get-involved.qmd). Avoid sharing personal information in public issues.
